a: One month's rent, charged only once the rental agreement is signed. Visits, shortlisting and paperwork help are free.
Two full bedrooms plus a smaller third room (about 80–95 sq ft) that works as a study, guest room or kids' room. It has a window but is usually not big enough for a queen bed.

q: How much deposit should I expect?
a: Owners at Abode Valley usually ask for 3 to 6 months' rent. Every listing shows the exact figure, and the rent calculator adds it to your move-in total.

q: Do owners rent to students and bachelors?
a: Many do. Each listing shows the owner's preference: Family, Bachelors, Students or Any. Filter by it on the listings page.

q: Can parents sign the agreement for a student?
a: Yes. Most student agreements are signed by a parent or guardian as the primary tenant. We can arrange e-signing if you're not in Chennai.
Maintenance is paid monthly to the association and depends on the flat size, usually ₹2.2–2.8 per sq ft. It's listed separately on every flat.
Government ID (Aadhaar/passport), a recent photo, and proof of work or a college ID. For students, the guardian's ID as well. We draft the agreement and handle registration.

q: How fast can I move in?
a: If the flat is marked available, usually within 3–5 days of the token advance, once the agreement is signed and the deposit is paid.

q: Are you the developer or Stanza Living?
a: No. We're an independent rental brokerage. We work with individual flat owners at Abode Valley and list nearby co-living rooms for comparison.
